Problem Statement:
Given a number N and an array of N elements ,find the Bitwise AND of the array elements.
input_spec: The input consists of an integer N, representing the size of the array, followed by N array elements. N <= 100000.
output_spec: The output is the Bitwise AND of all elements in the array.
